A_complete_reason: Complete-coverage population has only 1 positive ward(s); metrics there are descriptive only, not a comparison.
B_support_reason: Frequency is 0 or 1 for every ward and is identical to target A. Every detection occurs in a ward with only one available event, or in ward 16 where both events are positive; no ward has a 0.5 frequency. Target B is not separable from target A on this dataset.
notes: A ward with one available event is partial coverage, not a confirmed dry ward.
Target B is event-weighted; target A is ward-weighted.
No ward absent from the frozen table is assigned a label.

A_any_detection.definition: 1 if at least one available event has a proxy detection; 0 if all available events are non-detections.
A_any_detection.limitation: Ignores recurrence; a one-event ward can be a negative with partial coverage; non-detection is not confirmed dryness.
A_any_detection.population: all wards with at least one available event

B_detection_frequency.definition: detections / available events (0, 0.5 or 1 for two events).
B_detection_frequency.limitation: Event-weighted, not ward-weighted; only two events; frequency 0 does not establish dryness; partial coverage is excluded.
B_detection_frequency.population: complete-coverage wards only (both events available) for primary; all wards as a sensitivity.
